heading: `emit X logical` on any schema
text:
### `emit X logical` on any schema [LNOG.3.2]

An `emit` action with the `logical` keyword is a compile
error (`DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_DISABLED`, [LDIA.3.4.2]) regardless of the
schema's declared lifecycle.

Rationale: even if a schema is not declared `logical`, the `logical`
qualifier on an emit action would require a TMS entry for the resulting
fact.  The TMS is absent under `logical: false`.

The remedy is to remove the keyword: under `logical: false` no schema in
the compilation unit is declared `logical` ([LNOG.3.1]), so the keyword
has nothing it could correctly apply to.
